core_question: How do I sharpen a dull kitchen knife at home? (secondary: How do you replace worn, slick grip tape on a golf club?)
answer_summary: Hold the blade at a consistent angle and draw it across a whetstone from heel to tip on both sides repeatedly, then finish by honing on a honing steel.; after the topic shift: Cut off the old grip, remove the old double-sided tape, wrap fresh grip tape on the shaft, apply grip solvent, and quickly slide the new grip on before the solvent flashes off, then let it cure.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; texting quickly with typos here and there
